title: Table has rows
meaning: Script 08 produced nothing. Check its inputs.

title: One row per pitch
meaning: The same pitch appears twice. A merge fanned out — every count and rate downstream is inflated.

title: Counts are legal
meaning: A count outside these bounds means the pre-pitch state is wrong.

title: Challenges remaining within 0-2
meaning: Teams start with 2 and the extra-inning grant only restores a side to 1, so nothing can ever exceed 2. This is r in your MDP.

title: Every game starts at 2 each
meaning: The per-game reset is broken — inventory is carrying across games.

title: No opportunity for a side with zero challenges
meaning: An opportunity requires a challenge in hand. If this fires, the denominator for your behaviour model is wrong.

title: Nobody challenges with zero left
detail: 4 challenges made with no challenge remaining
meaning: Either the inventory walk is wrong or a challenge event was mis-attributed to the wrong side.

title: Challenges are present
meaning: No challenges matched onto pitches at all — the join failed.

title: Challenged pitches are called pitches
meaning: You can only challenge a taken pitch. These are join errors — most likely pitch_number is off by one.

title: Challenger is batter, catcher or pitcher
detail: 119 of 8,012 (1.5%) with a missing or invalid role
meaning: Only those three may challenge, so a null role means the API payload had no reviewDetails.player. A few is normal and they drop out of any role-split analysis; above 2% suspect the extraction in script 02.

title: Every challenge has an outcome
meaning: is_overturned is your model target, so these rows cannot train anything and are excluded from every rate on this page. A handful is tolerable; more means script 02 is mis-reading the review payload.

title: No side exceeds its failed-challenge budget
meaning: A side can lose at most 2 in regulation plus 1 per extra inning. Over budget means the inventory never decremented.

title: ABS zone reproduces actual challenge outcomes
meaning: Your reconstructed ABS zone disagrees with what ABS actually ruled. The zone constants, the ball-radius rule or the batter heights are wrong — and every distance feature inherits the error.

title: Challenge events matched onto pitches
meaning: Unmatched challenges are usually the at_bat_number off-by-one (Statcast 1-based vs Stats API 0-based) or pitch numbering that counts pickoffs.

title: home-plate umpire coverage
meaning: A sparse home-plate umpire column means that covariate is mostly missing from the model.

title: batter height coverage
meaning: A sparse batter height column means that covariate is mostly missing from the model.

title: leverage index coverage
meaning: A sparse leverage index column means that covariate is mostly missing from the model.

title: ABS zone built from batter height
meaning: Rows falling back to Statcast's sz_top/sz_bot have an approximated zone. Run 07_player_bios.py and rebuild.

title: Overturn rate is plausible
meaning: Far outside this band suggests mis-parsed outcomes.

title: Catchers out-challenge batters
meaning: MLB has publicly reported catchers are the most successful challengers. If your data says otherwise, suspect the data before the finding.

title: Opportunity share near Savant's ~50%
meaning: Savant reports about half of 2026 pitches are challenge opportunities. A big gap means the opportunity rule is off.

title: 'Reasonable pitch' share near ~5%
meaning: Ours is a simplified version of Savant's definition, so some drift is expected — but not a lot.

title: Overturn rate falls as pitches move from the zone edge
meaning: Calls far from the edge are obvious, so they should almost never be overturned. If this doesn't hold, the distance feature is wrong and Week 7's model has nothing to learn from.

title: Mean leverage index near 1.0
meaning: Leverage is scaled so the average plate appearance is 1.0.
